title: Does Elizabeth Holmes seem genuine? A Conveo social study
summary: We asked 47 US consumers if “You Can See Everything” changes how genuine Elizabeth Holmes seems. It makes her more human, but doubt remains.
body_markdown:
-


We ran 47 recorded interviews with US consumers about the new documentary “You Can See Everything” and a moment from its trailer.


-


Among the 20 film viewers who rated her before and after, mean genuineness ratings rose from 24 to 34 out of 100 after the film. The sample is small, so read this as directional.


-


The trailer moment scored a mean believability of 23.3 and a median of 11 out of 100.


-


“Why would I deceive you?” was the line most often ranked the biggest red flag, by 48% of film viewers and 33% of non-viewers.
